none: PAS CAM-638EF3: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. AD330-335, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows Two soldiers, two standards. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]O[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.7g, diameter is 16mm
